steps.name: Bena
steps.text: The children have been safekeeping quite the nouveau things as of late.

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: A model of Rhodes Island—a camera—

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: And this rather valuable-seeming gold coin.

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: You just don't see sweeties and milk teeth as often these days.

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: But new things might need to be handled a little differently compared to the old. Will it make any trouble if we don't go by the books, I wonder...?

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: When I can, I should drop back in on Grandmother sometime. And ask her if she's got any idea while I'm there.

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: What is it, Annie? I'm occupied.

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: Delivery fairy? Is it time we made good on some Rhodes Island grown-up's childhood wish?

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: Oh, a child called Bena's... I thought I was familiar with every child aboard, but I don't think any of them were named Bena.

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: I certainly don't remember entrusting any safekeepings to Granny.

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: I just told you I didn't.

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: Harrumph... Let me take a look, then.

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: What have we here... a letter?

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: Seemingly not... all these boxes... and Grandmother's signature.

steps.name: Annie
steps.text: You make a wish with it.

steps.name: Annie
steps.text: Fill in a number, and you get money.

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: Sounds like the sort of thing grown-ups would be fond of.

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: But what's Grandmother sent me this for?

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: She must've found that fruit pit I hid under her pillow last time I went to the Castle!

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: Oh-hoh-hoh, trust Granny to send this sort of nonsense as a practical joke.

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: Well, she certainly succeeded with flying colors this time.

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: A gold coin... hmm, how did we handle gold coins again...?

steps.name: Annie
steps.text: Bena, I'm off to fetch the lucky doll.

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: Yes, yes, be careful out of doors, don't get lost.

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: Hrmm. What does the manual say—

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: I think that should do it.

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: Annie, my work is done! Let's go out and play!

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: Come on, chop-chop while we can! There'll be evening classes soon!

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: The silly girl's ditched me to have her own fun again.

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: Well, after spending so long sat on my bottom, a little exercise is in order.

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: Let's see where we'll be tagging Annie today.

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: Hmm... another fork in the road.

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: Time I asked Sir Barkel—mm, actually, let's shake it up for today.

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: Bena, Bena, oh lost Miss Prim♪ Where to go? Just listen to ♪ her ♪

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: Here comes Dame Ingres♪ The way she'll confer♪

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: I just knew you'd be here. Have you been filching toys from Kirara's again?

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: The nerve of sneaking out to play here without telling me... hmm?

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: Well, well... a child's doll? Whose is it?

steps.name: Annie
steps.text: I don't know. It was in the playmate pile.

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: It does seem a little uncanny, I'll say...

steps.name: Annie
steps.text: If you're late, you have to give a presentation to everyone.

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: Urk... You should be coming to class with me! That way we'd have a trick for any nag.

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: The teacher tonight has a sense of humor, so a quick prank should fly. It won't be totally boring.

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: I'll be off, then. Remember to return soon; I want to see you waiting in our room tonight.

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: Hmm... what was the way to evening class again...?

steps.name: Annie
steps.text: Can I make her remember this?

steps.name: Annie
steps.text: She promised Granny. She needs to remember.

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: Huff... Well, today's class was interesting.

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: The teacher asked us what wishes we have, and the things started pouring out of everyone's mouths. Then we all wrote them down onto letters and handed them to the teacher, who arranged that we could come and fetch them in ten years' time.

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: My, my, that's our job to the T.

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: I collected plenty of articles as we went along, so Grandmother's sure to be pleased.

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: What? If Iris were attending that class, she'd have done the same thing.

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: I just saw a move or two ahead, you see? Haha!

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: Mmf. Still, as voluntary as it is... I can't argue taking classes in the evening is a little...

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: No thank you. I'm no child, you know.

steps.name: Mummy
steps.text: I... I feel so sorry for her...

steps.name: Daddy
steps.text: We can only hope to keep the malady from reaching her too...

steps.name: Daddy
steps.text: We'll be in Victoria soon, and then...

steps.name: Daddy
steps.text: ■■, Daddy and Mummy are going to buy some food from a shop over there. Just sit here and rest yourself for now.
I don't want it. I just want Mummy and Daddy to stay.
I just want... just want to be with Mummy and Daddy...

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: You're all the family I have...

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: And I thought we were clear we didn't have anything to do with each other.

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: Mgh... Iris does make delicious tarts.

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: Be honest. Where did you learn all that babying talk?

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: Isn't she more fond of those action games?

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: I'll have to take a peek at her collection next time.

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: For now, let's get some sleep. Proper sleep.

steps.name: Annie
steps.text: Remember to give Grandmother your reply tomorrow.

steps.name: Annie
steps.text: Rock-a-bye~♪ Rock-a-bye~♪ There's a moon round and bright~♪

steps.name: Annie
steps.text: Are we going out to play?

steps.name: Annie
steps.text: I found the lucky doll for us.

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: Pink, with two little knives, stitches and patches all over, who you can make a wish to if you happen to meet? And then your next few days are awfully lucky, was it?

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: Sounds like the perfect wool to pull over children's eyes.

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: And you don't suppose the doll has a Castle of Dreams-type place trailing it about, too...

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: So you found it yesterday. Has your wish come true?

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: Has it, or has it not?

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: Oh, don't learn to keep mum as well, Annie, that won't do!

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: *sigh* Come on, we're going to find that doll together.

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: But from what I heard, it was awfully hard to find it. Sometimes it even runs away when it's seen. Do you really think you can fetch it again?

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: Hmph... So you've started making friends behind my back to boot. Naughty.

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: Erm... why are we here again?

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: What a mountainous pile of playmates.

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: Let me see where that little rapscallion is hidden.

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: Nor this one, I don't think.

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: Hum. So there are sound-making dolls nowadays?

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: Err... the color's right, but it hasn't any knives, and it's not shabby, so I wouldn't think so...

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: There's a hint of evil about it...

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: What exquisite needlework. And sewn with some marvelous cloth, too.

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: Its owner must care for it very much.

steps.name: Annie
steps.text: Morte says you can make your wish.

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: A wish... Ooh, let me think.

steps.name: Slum Dweller
steps.text: Get out of my sight and never come back!

steps.name: Grandmother
steps.text: Let this be your home from now on, little lamb.

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: Hello, I'm Iris. We'll be friends from now on.

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: There's oodles of toys in the playroom, and plenty of people to play with them together, so what's the harm in staying a little longer?

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: (Ah, I remember her. Shamare, I think? Hilariously difficult to get along with.)

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: (Last time I asked if she wanted to safekeep anything, she put a curse on me!)

steps.name: Annie
steps.text: (Because you kept pestering her. It was very annoying.)

steps.name: Shamare
steps.text: It's Morte. I can only patch it up. It'll always fall apart.

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: Alright, alright, I'll go and do it.

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: Shamare, preparing your symbols and doing this patchwork must be a terrible burden.

spans.text: doing this patchwork must be a terrible burden.

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: I can handle the patchwork half for you. Think of it as thanks for the apple.

steps.name: Shamare
steps.text: Then you take Morte. I'll draw my symbols.

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: Good, a complete set of tools. Looks like it gets damaged quite often.

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: Does needlework like this hurt it?

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: Hmm... I'm fairly sure it does. I can feel it.

steps.name: Annie
steps.text: But that's alright. I'm still here.

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: Next time, could you just ask Kirara to lend me that adventure game for a few days?

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: Look at you. Your mouth is covered in honey.

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: *sigh* Let's get started. I'd feel bad about eating her apples before I finish darning, after all.

steps.name: Shamare
steps.text: It says you sewed it very well.

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: No, no, it's nothing. I'm a dab hand when it comes to handiwork, you know.

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: I still get that uncanny feeling...

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: *sigh* Who knew wishes could come real so fast?

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: I'm surprised she likes her apples this sweet. You'd never guess from how unapproachable she is.

steps.name: Annie
steps.text: Bena, no judging books by their covers.

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: Let's sit here a little while longer, and then we're off to Rhodes Island for a grand adventure, okay?

steps.name: Annie
steps.text: But before that, there's something you need to do, Bena.

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: That's the... check, that... Grandmother sent me.

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: Are pranks the sort of thing you reply to, now...?

steps.name: Grandmother
steps.text: I forgot to ask. Little lamb, what's your name?
I—I don't know... they call me things like little wretch, or bastard girl, or Caprinae imp...

steps.name: Grandmother
steps.text: Those aren't names. Forget about those.

steps.name: Grandmother
steps.text: From now on, if anyone dares bully you again, use the Arts and the self-defense Granny's taught you to sort them out.
But, Granny, you haven't... taught me yet...

steps.name: Grandmother
steps.text: Ho-ho-ho, all in due time, little lamb, all in due time. Granny will teach you everything.

steps.name: Grandmother
steps.text: For now, let's give you a name.

steps.name: Grandmother
steps.text: Hm... how about... we call you 'Bena'?

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: Be... na. Bena. It sounds pretty. And... rings a bell.

steps.name: Grandmother
steps.text: There was once a pair of dearly close children who were soon to part, who entrusted to Granny a letter to safekeep.

steps.name: Grandmother
steps.text: Should they be wed, their letter would be returned to them on the day their child was born, care of the Castle of Dreams.

steps.name: Grandmother
steps.text: It was the most complicated request I'd taken in a long while.

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: So, did they marry each other?

steps.name: Grandmother
steps.text: They did, little lamb, and they gave birth to an adorable little girl, and on that letter was written this girl's name.

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: But—they wouldn't know how many children they were going to have. What if they were twins?

steps.name: Grandmother
steps.text: There were a great many names on that letter, little lamb.

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: So if—if they had a second girl, what would she be named?

steps.name: Grandmother
steps.text: You see, little lamb? This is the work Granny does.

steps.name: Grandmother
steps.text: Someone has to be watching. Someone has to make good.

steps.name: Grandmother
steps.text: But Granny's old, now, and can't keep up with it anymore.

steps.name: Grandmother
steps.text: Little lamb, would you like to learn? To take on a little of Granny's work for her?

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: Of course, Granny. Am I learning to post letters?

steps.name: Grandmother
steps.text: No, little lamb, that you needn't learn.

steps.name: Grandmother
steps.text: 'The art of safekeeping'. That's what I'd like you to learn.

steps.name: Grandmother
steps.text: To preserve an item untouched, unchanging over decades and centuries, to be returned to one's hands just the same as when it had left.

steps.name: Grandmother
steps.text: Would you like to learn it?

steps.name: Grandmother
steps.text: Then allow me to commence the first lesson.

steps.name: Grandmother
steps.text: Everything, with no exception, has to begin from a wish.

steps.name: Grandmother
steps.text: Come make a wish, little lamb. Preserve a thing for future you.

steps.name: Grandmother
steps.text: What would you like to leave, to your future self?

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: I want money. Lots and lots of money.

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: Then I can search for my mummy and daddy, and I can have an even nicer life.

steps.name: Grandmother
steps.text: A fine wish, little lamb. Truly, a fine one.

steps.name: Grandmother
steps.text: Granny will gladly fulfill this wish of yours.

steps.name: Grandmother
steps.text: But Granny would like to wager with you, too.

steps.name: Grandmother
steps.text: To wager whether, on the day you get it, you'll wish it was something different, something even more precious.

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: What's more precious than lots and lots of money?

steps.name: Grandmother
steps.text: When the day comes, hmm... how long away do you want it?

steps.name: Grandmother
steps.text: Five years from now, the moment it reaches you, you write on it however much money it is you want, then take it to a bank, and the money will be yours.

steps.name: Grandmother
steps.text: I'll be looking forward to your answer.

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: Ah! You did this, didn't you!

steps.name: Annie
steps.text: Annie's done a lot of things.

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: That funny lucky doll business with Morte, that was you!

steps.name: Annie
steps.text: Shamare's trying hard to turn her curses into blessings.

steps.name: Annie
steps.text: Annie borrowed it for a bit.

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: So you wished to have me remember to reply to Grandmother?

steps.name: Annie
steps.text: Yes. But it didn't work very well.

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: Mnnn... never mind. It didn't matter too much anyhow. I forgive you.

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: Now, let's put our heads together and think up our response to Granny.

steps.name: Annie
steps.text: How much money do you want, Bena?

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: Even if we were able to buy up all of Rhodes Island, or the entire Castle of Dreams, or the whole of Victoria, I feel like what's bound to happen would happen anyway. Especially the bad things.

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: Seeing as I thought it was a prank in the first place, we'll prank her right back!

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: Now get some apple juice. I hear apple juice can write invisible letters. This way, I can really play a joke on Granny.

steps.name: Annie
steps.text: I just squeezed some from the leftover core.

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: Hmm... what do we write in this box, now?

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: Eat apples... smile everyday... fool about...

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: Post it back? This is the most marvelous practical joke ever. How could we post it back?

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: Iris was wanting to go back and see Granny soon, wasn't she?

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: And I'll hand it back to Granny in person, and see how she reacts. That'll be interesting.

spans.text: And I'll hand it back to Granny in person, and see how she reacts.

steps.name: Annie
steps.text: You'll have to pretend you completely forgot about it, too.

steps.name: Annie
steps.text: Grandmother will be sure to furrow her brows.

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: Oh, you're right! Now THAT'S a worthy spectacle!

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: I'm already dying to see the confusion on her face!
